title: 2026 Annual investor update
gist: A logistics notice saying Glencore plc will hold its 2026 annual investor update on Monday 7 December 2026 at 11:00 UK. The slides go up on its website at 10:30, the event is a live audio webcast, and a replay will be available within 24 hours. The notice contains no strategy, financial or commodity content.

insights.claim: Glencore plc will hold its annual investor update presentation on Monday 7 December 2026 at 11:00 UK time.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Mark 7 December 2026 as a potential catalyst date for Glencore shares, when management strategy and guidance are likely updated.
insights.quote: Glencore plc will host an annual investor update presentation on Monday, 7 December 2026 at 11.00 am UK.

insights.claim: Glencore will publish the investor update slides for download in the Publications section of its website at 10:30 UK time, half an hour before the presentation begins.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Slide content will be available 30 minutes before the live commentary, giving an early look at disclosures.
insights.quote: At 10.30 am UK the investor update presentation slides will be available for download from the Publications section of our website.

insights.claim: Glencore's investor update will be streamed as a live audio-only webcast starting at 11:00 UK time.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: The event is audio-only, so the slide deck is the main visual source for any figures shown.
insights.quote: A live audio webcast starting at 11.00 am UK will be accessible at:

insights.claim: An on-demand replay of Glencore's investor update will be available within 24 hours of the presentation ending, at the same link as the live webcast, and the presentation will be archived on the company website.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Anyone missing the live event can review management commentary within a day.
insights.quote: an on-demand replay will be available within 24 hours of the presentation ending at the same link as the live webcast

insights.claim: Martin Fewings is Glencore's investor relations contact for the update, with a separate australia.investors mailbox for Australian investors, reflecting Glencore's Australian shareholder base.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Investor questions about the update go to Martin Fewings, and Australian holders have their own channel.

insights.claim: Charles Watenphul and Francis De Rosa are listed as Glencore's media contacts, with De Rosa reachable on an Australian number.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Media inquiries about the investor update go to these named Glencore press contacts.
